s.how: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with lemon slices. Add 500g green prawns and poach 2 minutes, then plunge into iced water. Peel and serve on crushed ice with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce and hot sauce.

s.note: the Spanish fleet racing for the Fountain
s.how: Toss 150g green olives and 150g kalamata olives with strips of orange peel, sliced garlic, a pinch of chilli and olive oil. Leave for an hour. Serve with thin wedges of manchego for a Spanish galleon crew.

m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck, then add 2 sliced onions and 3 carrots. Stir in 125ml dark rum, a teaspoon of allspice and water to cover. Simmer for 3 hours until dark and thick. Serve with crusty bread on a haunted ship.

w.note: Jack eating the cream puffs at the palace
w.how: Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g flour, then beat in 4 eggs. Pipe small mounds and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Fold whipped cream into custard, fill each puff and dust with icing sugar. Royal treats.

d.note: the waters of the Fountain of Youth
d.how: Fill glasses with ice. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice and squeeze in half a lime. Add 30ml dark rum for those drinking. Two chalices, one with a tear, is optional.
